:::{#exm-lp-norm}
#### The $L^1$ and $L^2$ norms of $x \mapsto x$ on $[0, 1]$

Let $S = [0, 1]$ with the [Lebesgue measure](#def-lebesgue-measure) $\measure$,
and let $f(x) = x$.
By @def-lp-norm,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\norm{f}_1
&= \int_0^1 x \, dx \\
&= \frac{1}{2},
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
\norm{f}_2
&= \paren{\int_0^1 x^2 \, dx}^{1/2} \\
&= \paren{\frac{1}{3}}^{1/2}.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
